architectureReviews.rationale: ArtifactEditor owns a cohesive notes/debrief presentation and local interaction lifecycle: list cards, edit/share dialogs, preview selection and pending/uncertain draft feedback. It delegates native request/receipt semantics and lifetime fencing to artifacts/api, contracts and useArtifactMutation, generation eligibility/workflow to DebriefGeneration, and saved preview to its existing owner. The correction changes only whether the generation child is mounted: local pending/uncertain writes suppress new input, while role/runtime disabled presentation remains with the generation child. It adds no persistence, backend authority or independent domain. Keep this 248-line composition; extracting solely for line count would scatter one artifact interaction invariant. The added sharing caption distinguishes omitted metadata from explicit null without normalizing unknown state or inventing an endpoint or action.
